tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Deepest ground: map canvas, video feed letterbox, HUD overlays. Text on accent-hud and signal fills.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. Default ground for ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, telemetry tiles raised one step off surface-100.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders, dividers, grid lines, table rules. Decoration only — never a control's only boundary.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numerals on surface-000/100/200.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: units, labels, timestamps, captions on surface-100/200. Also control borders.

tokens.name: accent-hud
tokens.usage: HUD phosphor green: primary action, focus ring, nominal/OK state, armed-safe telemetry. Text on it uses surface-000.

tokens.name: signal-cyan
tokens.usage: Info, navigation: waypoints, mission path, links, selected row.

tokens.name: signal-amber
tokens.usage: Caution: low battery warning, weak link, GPS degraded. Always paired with a label or icon.

tokens.name: signal-red
tokens.usage: Critical: failsafe, battery critical, link lost, destructive actions. Never decorative.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen titles, mission name on the report cover.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text, form values, report notes.
styles.sample: Takeoff from point B, wind 6 m/s NW.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field labels, tile captions, button text.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Live numbers in telemetry tiles: altitude, speed, voltage. Tabular figures, never animate the digits.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Coordinates, logs, IDs, table cells with numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, unit after a number.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between label and value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tile and card padding, gap between tiles.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing, page gutter on desktop; the base grid pitch.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, bottom sheets, the map frame.
